name: AvSight Intelligence
summary: AI agents inside the AvSight aviation ERP that price RFQ lines, build quotes from structured and email requests, and send follow-ups on open quotes.
paragraphs: AI agents inside the AvSight aviation ERP that price RFQ lines, build quotes from structured and email requests, and send follow-ups on open quotes.
whyItMatters: For parts sellers and MROs already on AvSight, the quote agent turns inbound RFQs into draft quotes your team reviews instead of builds.
